title: "Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026" — Vande Mataram
summary: Extends the same statutory protection to National Song Vande Mataram as the National Anthem.

blocks.content: Extends the same statutory protection to National Song Vande Mataram as the National Anthem.

items: Passed Rajya Sabha Jul 29 → Lok Sabha Jul 30 → **President Murmu's assent confirmed Aug 11, 2026** — now law
Penalty: up to 3 yrs jail/fine/both; repeat conviction min. 1 yr
Composed by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay (1870s), 1st published 1882 (*Anandamath*)
Will be sung from Red Fort ramparts for the 1st time this Independence Day
